decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds on the firm's core postpress offer, has kept its own dedicated page in both 2023 and 2024, and fits the move toward automated inline workflows, so it is likely to stay in the portfolio.

The folding add-on unit is close to the established offer, has a documented customer installation combining creasing, perforating, cutting and folding in one pass, and was still listed in 2024, though its lower website prominence suggests some risk of being phased out as a distributed add-on.
